aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab develops practical software for food trucks and mobile catering businesses: online orders, pickup times and fewer repeated questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We develop practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering businesses, helping them take online orders, manage pickup times, keep a smooth flow of orders and spend less time on repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: And yet, most of the software available to them was designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our goal is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around the way these businesses really operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started from a simple observation: food trucks need better tools for running the business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After I set up Village Foodie, a directory that helps people discover food trucks coming to their area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses deal with. Unlike regular restaurants, food trucks are constantly on the move, work in different places and serve customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see pickup times your kitchen can really meet. The system calculates from each dish’s prep time and how many you prepare at once.

comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month} two {The first two months} other {The first # months}} free, with every feature.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up a weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and the day you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing locations?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, with Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum commitment period and no notice period. You can cancel at any time; billing is monthly and in advance, and access stays until the end of the month you paid for.

comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till and has no TSE. How to record online orders in your till — that is a question for your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Is a till with a TSE still needed?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers even reach the food truck: they choose dishes and a pickup time, pay online or at pickup, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till or card terminal takes payment at the food truck. The two complement each other.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, taxes and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year, ready to download for the accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time, before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are approved automatically — no need to approve each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Attach a buzzer number to an order when you hand out a buzzer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers see, with the order numbers and when they’re ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map, so customers in the area find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place, such as hygiene approvals, insurance and gas safety. We remind you before anything expires, and you can send them to an event or market organiser in one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your website. Each date links straight to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to run HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, and also the only way to keep taking orders when there is no reception.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much the kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a time slot fills up, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward repeat customers with digital punch cards — punches are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Bundle items into deals and offer add-ons at the payment step, to raise the average order.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like the WhatsApp automatic replies, for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Run several screens — front counter and kitchen — all showing the same orders in real time.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Personal logins for staff members, with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: When there is no reception, online orders are paused, so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app keeps taking orders offline; the browser dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Charge card payment upfront when customers order online, through Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a cut-off time for items that need a pre-order.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t appear on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter what each dish costs you, and see how much you really earned at every event, not just the turnover.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens the menu and the ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in the schedule automatically — from your website, or from a picture you already post on Facebook. You just check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Send customers an automatic SMS when the order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add the dates, places and times for every week and every event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as “sold out” in one tap — it shows greyed out to customers immediately.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock quantity, and it goes down with every order that comes in, then the item is marked “sold out” automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, with no need for a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Printing order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a pickup time slot, and demand spreads across the service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Taking and managing orders at the food truck counter, paid on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run the service from any browser on a phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: WhatsApp automatic replies to enquiries about the menu and the schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much can be cooked at once and how long it takes. When a pickup time fills up, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in the apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the food truck — and on the card terminal you already take payment on.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume there is a fixed address, stable internet and the same hours every week. You are somewhere else every week, at different hours, with weak reception or no reception at all. HatchGrab was built exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If reception disappears, online orders pause automatically, so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. Keep taking orders with the app for iPhone, iPad and Android.

landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a pickup time. Fewer queues, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Built for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “Which desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp gets answered while you are on the way to the spot or by the grill, based on your menu and schedule. Soon on Messenger and Instagram too.
